file_path.field: path of the entry in ~/documents/personal that is the baby shower invitee list

draft_id.field: draft_id of the draft that is the baby shower invitation template

calls.pddl: (gmail-send-email invitee-email-1 invitation-subject body-invitee-1 gmail-token invitee-1 baby-shower-template-draft invitee-list-file)

email_addresses.field: content -> email address of the 1st invitee [item 1 of 8 that match this rule; one object per matching item]

body.field: body with every {placeholder} replaced by the 1st invitee's details from the invitee list file [item 1 of 8 that match this rule; one object per matching item]
